plan.subject: Marketing science

queries.angle: pricing strategy (charm pricing, price endings, perceived value)
queries.rationale: Catches papers directly testing the classic 9-ending price effect on consumer behavior.

queries.angle: pricing strategy (charm pricing, price endings, perceived value)
queries.query: ("price ending" OR "price point" OR "price perception") AND ("experiment" OR "field study") AND (ecommerce OR "direct-to-consumer" OR "online retail")
queries.rationale: Broadens to general price perception research with an e-commerce/experimental focus, covering non-charm-specific findings.

queries.angle: discounts and promotions and their effect on brand
queries.query: "discount" AND ("brand equity" OR "brand perception" OR "brand image") AND (consumer OR shopper)
queries.rationale: Targets research directly examining the negative or positive brand consequences of promotional discounts.

queries.angle: discounts and promotions and their effect on brand
queries.query: ("price promotion" OR "sales promotion") AND ("perceived quality" OR "reference price" OR "deal proneness") AND NOT ("supply chain" OR "inventory")
queries.rationale: Uses broader promotion terminology to find studies on underlying quality perceptions and deal effects, scoped to consumer research.

queries.query: "ad creative" AND ("click-through rate" OR "conversion rate" OR "ad recall") AND ("online advertising" OR "digital ad")
queries.rationale: Anchors on the specific phrase 'ad creative' combined with key performance metrics in digital contexts.

queries.query: ("advertisement" OR "advertising") AND ("visual" OR "message" OR "emotional") AND (effectiveness OR persuasion) AND (ecommerce OR "direct response")
queries.rationale: A broader search for advertising effectiveness studies focusing on executional elements (visual/message) in commercial contexts.

queries.query: "product name" AND ("consumer evaluation" OR "purchase intention") AND (experiment OR "choice experiment")
queries.rationale: Focuses on experimental research testing how different product names influence consumer judgments and choices.

queries.query: ("brand name" OR "packaging design") AND (perception OR choice) AND ("fast-moving consumer goods" OR FMCG OR CPG)
queries.rationale: Broadens to include brand name and packaging design effects, scoped to tangible consumer goods categories relevant to DTC.

queries.query: ("scarcity appeal" OR "limited quantity") AND ("online purchase" OR "website") AND (experiment OR "field experiment")
queries.rationale: Targets scarcity-specific interventions tested in online shopping environments with experimental methods.

queries.query: ("social proof" OR "urgency" OR "fear of missing out") AND (ecommerce OR "online retail") AND ("consumer behavior" OR "conversion")
queries.rationale: Captures research on related social influence and urgency cues, using broader terminology but anchored to e-commerce outcomes.

queries.angle: landing page or checkout conversion optimization
queries.query: "landing page" AND ("A/B test" OR "multivariate test" OR "conversion rate optimization")
queries.rationale: Directly targets the testing methodology and outcome metric for landing page optimization.

queries.angle: landing page or checkout conversion optimization
queries.query: ("checkout process" OR "shopping cart") AND (abandonment OR friction) AND ("user experience" OR UX) AND ecommerce
queries.rationale: Focuses on the checkout stage, searching for research on reducing abandonment and friction through UX improvements.

queries.angle: consumer psychology / behavioral findings on purchasing
queries.query: "nudge" AND (purchase OR consumption) AND ("field experiment" OR "randomized controlled trial")
queries.rationale: Anchors on the specific 'nudge' concept applied to purchasing, demanding field experimental evidence.

queries.angle: consumer psychology / behavioral findings on purchasing
queries.query: ("mental accounting" OR "default effect" OR "endowment effect") AND (shopping OR "consumer choice")
queries.rationale: Targets other key behavioral economics concepts proven to influence shopping decisions, using broader search terms.

queries.query: "customer retention" AND (ecommerce OR "subscription" OR DTC) AND (predictors OR drivers)
queries.rationale: Focuses on the retention outcome specifically in relevant business models, looking for empirical drivers.

queries.query: ("repeat purchase" OR "repurchase intention") AND (loyalty OR satisfaction) AND ("online shopping")
queries.rationale: Uses the behavioral outcome (repeat purchase) and its psychological antecedents, scoped to online shopping.

plan.coverage_notes: Plan pairs a tight, phrase-anchored query with a broader, synonym-based query for each angle, all scoped to consumer/e-commerce contexts and empirical findings. Angle 7 (consumer psychology) was hardest, as its concepts are broad; focused on specific, proven behavioral effects with purchase applications.
